svg.title: good 4 u step by step: sound, spectrogram, bars, embeddings, the bar-against-bar comparison, and named sections
svg.text: 1 Sound. The song as it arrives.
2 Spectrogram. The same sound, split by pitch.
3 Bars. A beat tracker finds 104 bar lines.
frozen audio model, one bar at a time
4 Embeddings. Each bar's 3,840 numbers, as a colour.
5 Compare. Every bar against every other. Dark is alike.
6 Cut and name. The squares become sections.
